blocks.title: Functions and modules
blocks.text: Functions group reusable blocks of code under a name; modules organize a program by grouping related functions together in a file.
Together they make code efficient and organized.

blocks.prompt: How is a module different from a function?
blocks.explanation: A function is one named, reusable block of code; a module is a file that can hold many related functions (and variables and classes).

items: Functions: reusable named blocks; modules: files grouping related functions.
